_comment: GV-53 fixture: cached RSS feeds, keyed by catalogue show_id. The suite writes each one to <cacheDir>/<show_id>.xml, the file loadFeed reads; nothing here is ever fetched. legacy-ambig-1840705 and legacy-ambig-2456080 are two distinct guids whose sha1 shares the 10-hex prefix f400d5dd07 (found by brute force), so a legacy key with that hash is genuinely ambiguous.
